response.rationale: Young woman with VF arrest, normal QT, normal echo wall thickness; PVCs and VF in setting of stress favor catecholaminergic polymorphic VT over LQTS (QTc normal) or HCM (wall thickness normal).

rejected.why: QTc 380 ms is normal, not prolonged, contradicting Long QT Syndrome.
Echocardiography shows normal wall thickness, which contradicts hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
